First, using the power law for exponents, we can write our expression as

$$
5^{2/3} = 5^{2\cdot (1/3)} = \left(5^2\right)^{1/3}.
$$

The fractional exponent $x^{1/n}$ can be written as the radical $\sqrt[n]{x}.$

Comparing $x^{1/n}$ with our expression above, we get $x = 5^2$ and $n = 3.$ Therefore,

$$
\left(5^2\right)^{1/3} = \sqrt[3]{5^2}.
$$
